messages:
zoe: Quick RFC follow-up: propose splitting router "lanes" (fast, background) and moving decisioning to a tiny Arbiter service. Main win: avoid in-flight pinning during rollbacks.

mark: sounds good. Need clear actions: PASS (new goes to next), DRAIN (finish in-flight then stop new assigns), FORCE (block new binds immediately).

eli: FORCE is risky with streaming/KV. Must not kill mid-stream. Recommend enforced 'grace_window' so active streams finish, plus per-tenant max_active override.

zoe: proto sketch for decisions: includes decision_id, tenant, action, drain_until, ttl, confidence, signer, api_version. Example in RFC.

ops-bot: alert: canary r-3002 saw p99 spike @1732100022

mark: arbiter should require hysteresis: e.g., 3 failing probes over 10m or confidence>0.9 to promote to FORCE. Manual overrides still immediate.

eli: migration: opt-in per-tenant; mirror arbiter -> controller for 24-48h, diff; CLI to promote when mismatch < 0.5%. Router caches last signed decision until ttl.

zoe: security: sign decisions (JWT) and include decision_id in traces for audit. Add rollout_heartbeat metric.

mark: operational playbook: kill-switch to ignore arbiter if mismatch_count high or arbiter down, fallback to controller. Log and page if fallback persists.

zoe: I'll draft RFC with envelope proto, migration checklist, SLO impact, and operator runbook. Posting to eng-platform next week.

eli: :thumbsup:
